references.text: Laban accuses Jacob of mocking him by stealing his household gods, a similar use of the Hebrew word 'התעלל' (to mock/abuse)
God tells Moses that he has mocked the Egyptians; the same Hebrew root word 'התעלל' is used
The men of Gibeah abused the concubine all night long; the same Hebrew expression for abuse/mockery is used
The Philistines ask why they should harden their hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh did when God mocked them, using the same root word
Saul asks his armor-bearer to kill him with a sword so that the Philistines will not abuse him; thematic link to the desire for a sword and fear of abuse
The angel tells Balaam that if the donkey had not turned aside, the angel would have killed Balaam—an ironic contrast to Balaam's threat to kill the donkey
